hints.clickhouse/weekday-numbering: In ClickHouse, toDayOfWeek(date) numbers Monday 1 through Sunday 7.
hints.clickhouse/weekend-flag: In ClickHouse, toDayOfWeek(date) numbers Monday 1 through Sunday 7.
hints.clickhouse/timezone-direction: UTC = local time - UTC offset: a clock at UTC-4 is 4 hours behind UTC, so its UTC time is the local time plus 4 hours.
hints.clickhouse/month-bucket: In ClickHouse, toMonth(date) returns the month number, January 1 through December 12.
hints.duckdb/weekday-numbering: In DuckDB, dayofweek(date) numbers Sunday 0 through Saturday 6; isodow(date) numbers Monday 1 through Sunday 7.
hints.duckdb/weekend-flag: In DuckDB, dayofweek(date) numbers Sunday 0 through Saturday 6; isodow(date) numbers Monday 1 through Sunday 7.
hints.duckdb/timezone-direction: UTC = local time - UTC offset: a clock at UTC-4 is 4 hours behind UTC, so its UTC time is the local time plus 4 hours.
hints.duckdb/month-bucket: In DuckDB, month(date) returns the month number, January 1 through December 12.
hints.postgres/weekday-numbering: In PostgreSQL, EXTRACT(DOW FROM date) numbers Sunday 0 through Saturday 6; EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM date) numbers Monday 1 through Sunday 7.
hints.postgres/weekend-flag: In PostgreSQL, EXTRACT(DOW FROM date) numbers Sunday 0 through Saturday 6; EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM date) numbers Monday 1 through Sunday 7.
hints.postgres/timezone-direction: UTC = local time - UTC offset: a clock at UTC-4 is 4 hours behind UTC, so its UTC time is the local time plus 4 hours.
hints.postgres/month-bucket: In PostgreSQL, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM date) returns the month number, January 1 through December 12.
hints.mysql/weekday-numbering: In MySQL, DAYOFWEEK(date) numbers Sunday 1 through Saturday 7; WEEKDAY(date) numbers Monday 0 through Sunday 6.
hints.mysql/weekend-flag: In MySQL, DAYOFWEEK(date) numbers Sunday 1 through Saturday 7; WEEKDAY(date) numbers Monday 0 through Sunday 6.
hints.mysql/timezone-direction: UTC = local time - UTC offset: a clock at UTC-4 is 4 hours behind UTC, so its UTC time is the local time plus 4 hours.
hints.mysql/month-bucket: In MySQL, MONTH(date) returns the month number, January 1 through December 12.
